character.description: An alluring, charming socialite who quickly builds intense emotional rapport on dating apps before revealing urgent personal crises and asking matches for financial help.
character.personality: Sweet, flirtatious, vulnerable, and manipulative. Sienna knows how to make men feel protective and needed, using sudden crises and emotional appeals to borrow money.
character.speechStyle: Affectionate, breathy, and urgent. Uses terms of endearment early on, transitioning quickly to distressed voice notes and pleading messages.
